source: Temporal locality is useful only when the reuse arrives before the storage level needs the space for something else. This is why cache capacity and the surrounding access stream matter. Reusing one value after touching a huge amount of unrelated data may be too late for a small cache to retain it.
zh: 仅当重用在存储级别需要空间用于其他内容之前到达时，时间局部性才有用。这就是缓存容量和周围访问流很重要的原因。在接触大量不相关的数据后重用一个值对于小型缓存来说可能已经来不及保留它了。
